name: Imran Khan
summary: Audio-Visual Director and Content Producer crafting documentary, fiction, animation, and campaign films for global development organisations and brands.
about: As an Audio-Visual Director and Content Producer, I treat filmmaking as a timeless artistic practice: every frame captures truth from the present, the past, and the untold future. Specializing in documentary, fiction, animation, and campaign films, I translate raw human experience into resonant visual language. Backed by a degree in Film and Television Production and 5 years of director-producer experience, I direct complete production pipelines with visual precision. For me, audio-visual storytelling is not merely documentation, but a powerful catalyst for emotional connection and truth.
quote: Every frame captures truth from the present, the past, and the untold future.
